headlines.title: Exelon (EXC) Study Warns Northern Illinois Could Face Nearly Double Severe Rainfall
headlines.summary: Exelon (NasdaqGS:EXC) subsidiary ComEd and Argonne National Laboratory released a joint climate study for northern Illinois in 2026. The report projects almost double the number of severe rainfall events in northern Illinois by around mid century compared with today. Findings point to higher risks for Exelon's grid assets from flooding, ice storms, and shifting soil conditions in the region.

headlines.title: ComEd Joins Better Business Bureau, Peoples Gas and North Shore Gas to Warn Customers: Holiday Distractions Can Open the Door to Utility Scams
headlines.summary: CHICAGO, November 18, 2026--The holiday season brings shopping, gatherings, travel and plenty of distractions. It can also create an opening for utility scammers looking to take advantage of busy customers and pressure them into handing over money or personal information.

description: Exelon Corporation, a utility services holding company, engages in the energy distribution and transmission businesses in the United States. The company is involved in the purchase and regulated retail sale of electricity and natural gas; transmission and distribution of electricity; and distribution of natural gas to retail customers. It serves residential, commercial, industrial, and public authorities and electric railroads customers. Exelon Corporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
